description: A file of a doc, presentation or storyboard to download and attach: pdf or docx for a doc, pptx or pdf for a presentation, the frames as a zip for a storyboard (full size; zip_small to attach to a mail). To see how a presentation is drawn, read its pdf, or one slide as png with slide_id. Returns a download url that works for 15 minutes; the file is made when the url is fetched, which can take up to a minute for a presentation. An X-Missing-Pictures response header counts pictures that could not be reached and were left out.

doc_id.description: A doc id from get_task or list_space.

format.description: Leave out for the usual file of its type.

slide_id.description: One slide of a presentation, as a png: an id from its slides in read_doc.
